description: The Bing Webmaster Tools API: manage sites, submit URLs, and read query/traffic/crawl/link stats from the Bing search index.

novel_features.name: Query-performance delta review
novel_features.description: See which Bing queries you gained or lost, and how CTR and average position shifted, vs the previous period — not just a raw snapshot.

novel_features.name: Ranking-drift detection
novel_features.description: Track average-position movement per query and page over time and surface the biggest climbers and droppers.

novel_features.name: Quota-aware submission planning
novel_features.description: Read a real sitemap or URL file and live Bing quota, deduplicate the supplied URLs, and calculate quota-capped batches without submitting anything.

novel_features.name: Crawl-error triage
novel_features.description: Categorize crawl issues by severity, diff them against your last sync, and map each issue to the affected child URLs in one view.

novel_features.name: Submission quota intelligence
novel_features.description: One view of URL and content submission quota — daily and monthly remaining — plus a pacing recommendation.

novel_features.name: Bing-vs-Google coverage gap
novel_features.description: Reconcile your Bing query/page performance against a Google Search Console export to find queries and pages you rank for on one engine but not the other.

novel_features.name: Feed/sitemap health monitor
novel_features.description: Track submitted, discovered, and indexed counts for each feed over time and flag drops.

novel_features.name: Indexation watch
novel_features.description: Diff the latest sync against the previous one and surface indexation, crawl, and impression regressions per site.
